correctness.rationale: Exact Laplace solution yields d-hat=(qs+h)/[s(s+r_-)(s+r_+)]; r_± distinct positive for a,b,u,v>0. Positive kernel B strictly logconcave; its successive primitives strictly logconcave, making every F_j/F_{j+1} strictly decline from infinity to zero. This proves necessary/sufficient qh<0 unique strict crossing for all j, and integration plus F_{j+1}<=t F_j/j gives t_{j+1}>t_j and divergence. In equal exchange, B_k(s)/B_k(t) increases in k for 0<s<t, so instantaneous crossover strictly decreases, converging to explicit positive limit. SymPy transfer identities, exact example and actual verifier checks pass. No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The exact qh condition separates physically motivated early and steady sensor bias without an exchange-rate threshold, and the strictly ordered infinite integration hierarchy shows a structural reason why instantaneous and cumulative exposure comparisons can disagree for arbitrarily many observation conventions. The explicit mixing dependence gives a sharp testable benchmark for simplified building sensors, not a routine numerical parameter substitution. Limits exclude real stratification and variable sources.
